import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static final double DOUBLE_PRECISION = 1e-12;
    
    static class ModularInt {
        int val;
        
        ModularInt() { val = 0; }
        ModularInt(long v) { 
            val = (int)(v % MOD);
            if (val < 0) val += MOD;
        }
        
        ModularInt add(ModularInt other) {
            int res = val + other.val;
            if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
            return new ModularInt(res);
        }
        
        ModularInt subtract(ModularInt other) {
            int res = val - other.val;
            if (res < 0) res += MOD;
            return new ModularInt(res);
        }
        
        ModularInt multiply(ModularInt other) {
            return new ModularInt((long)val * other.val % MOD);
        }
        
        ModularInt multiply(long other) {
            return new ModularInt((long)val * other % MOD);
        }
        
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
            ModularInt that = (ModularInt) o;
            return val == that.val;
        }
        
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(val);
        }
        
        public String toString() {
            return String.valueOf(val);
        }
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        
        int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
        
        double[][] p = new double[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String[] line = br.readLine().trim().split("\\s+");
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                p[i][j] = Double.parseDouble(line[j]) / 100.0;
            }
        }
        
        long[] no = new long[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            long mask = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
                if (((j >> i) & 1) == 0) {
                    mask |= (1L << j);
                }
            }
            no[i] = mask;
        }
        
        Map<Long, ModularInt> m = new HashMap<>();
        m.put(1L, new ModularInt(1));
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Map<Long, ModularInt> M = new HashMap<>();
            for (Map.Entry<Long, ModularInt> entry : m.entrySet()) {
                long currentMask = entry.getKey();
                ModularInt currentProb = entry.getValue();
                
                for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
                    long res = 0;
                    double prob = 1.0;
                    
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                        if (((j >> k) & 1) == 1) {
                            prob *= p[i][k];
                            // This would be complex shift; we store as bitmask
                            // For proper translation we need to process differently
                        } else {
                            prob *= (1.0 - p[i][k]);
                        }
                    }
                    
                    // Build result mask
                    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                        if (((j >> k) & 1) == 1) {
                            long shifted = (currentMask & no[k]) << (1 << k);
                            res |= shifted;
                        }
                    }
                    
                    // Convert prob to modular
                    long probLong = (long)(prob * MOD);
                    probLong %= MOD;
                    ModularInt probMod = new ModularInt(probLong);
                    
                    ModularInt addVal = currentProb.multiply(probMod);
                    M.merge(res, addVal, (a, b) -> a.add(b));
                }
            }
            m = M;
        }
        
        long target = 1L << ((1 << n) - 1);
        ModularInt result = m.getOrDefault(target, new ModularInt(0));
        pw.println(result);
        
        br.close();
        pw.close();
    }
}
